description.value: Pleasant Valley Motel is a budget-friendly, family-run motel on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) in Houston, BC, operating since 1993. It includes an on-site casual restaurant serving hot, fresh meals, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists on this major northern BC corridor. The property also offers free parking and is pet-friendly upon request.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, operating motel with an on-site casual restaurant at 3030 Hwy 16 W in Houston, BC, matching the OSM address (Yellowhead Highway = Hwy 16). Free Wi-Fi is explicitly listed as an amenity for guests. No bike-specific infrastructure, bike parking, or food-service-specific details (takeout, menu dietary info) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM name 'Pleasant Valley Hotel Restaurant' does not match the website's consistent branding as 'Pleasant Valley Motel,' indicating the OSM record targets the restaurant component of the motel property.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pleasant Valley Hotel Restaurant' but the website consistently brands the business as 'Pleasant Valley Motel' — the word 'Hotel' appears incorrect; the restaurant is a component of the motel, not a standalone entity.

Website title contains a typo: 'Pleasant Vallet Motel' (likely 'Valley') — minor but may affect searchability.
Wi-Fi is described primarily as a guest amenity; availability to restaurant-only customers is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open restaurant and motel on the Yellowhead Highway in Houston, BC — a useful stop for touring cyclists on this major northern BC route.
